generalInfo.generalRule: Use of video cameras is prohibited within Nationwide Arena. For Blue Jackets games, professional cameras with attached lenses are permitted. accessibility.info: Tickets for accessible seats may be sold to individuals who require accessible seating themselves or to someone purchasing on their behalf. For each accessible seat that is required, up to three additional accessible seats for companions may be purchased. Select the available seats (blue dots) designated with the accessibility symbol. The "Show accessible seats"  toggle emphasizes these accessible seats by changing the non-accessible seats to a lighter shade of blue (after pressing the Apply Filters button).  Additional non-accessible seats may be purchased at the same time by selecting those seats anywhere within Nationwide Arena. If you have any questions about purchasing accessible seating or companion seating, if you would like to purchase a larger number of seats, or if you would like to inquire about other accommodations, please contact our ticket sales and service general line at (614) 246-3350.

events.name: Dead Man's Cell Phone
events.info: An incessantly ringing cell phone at the cafe table of a dead man leads Jean on a surreal journey where she encounters the dead mans family and mistress and eventually even speaks with the dead man himself. Sarah Ruhls magical realism comedy explores the nature of memory and how technology both connects and isolates us where the mundane cell phone becomes a magical device transporting her character beyond the boundaries of the living world to the afterlife. MacArthur Fellow Sarah Ruhl is one of the most widely produced playwrights in the United States. Previous Ohio State Theatre productions of Ruhls work include Orlando, In the Next Room (Or the Vibrator Play), and Eurydice.
